english.title: Distribute / sell thing / offer thing for sale / hire / make offer of services for reward within Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse or having first obtained the permission of Heathrow Airport Limited

(A)_[sold **(..SPECIFY THE THING SOLD..)]_
(B)_[distributed **(..SPECIFY THE THING DISTRIBUTED..)]_
(C)_[offered **(..SPECIFY THE THING OFFERED..) for sale or hire]_
(D)_[made an offer of services for reward, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SERVICES OFFERED..),]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) within Heathrow Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4.13 and 2.2 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
